errors.text_span: bis sie Mitte 2022 einen Wert von etwa 118 erreicht
errors.evidence: The purple line shows a value of approximately 115 from Jan 2022 to Jul 2022, and then jumps to approximately 123 in Jul 2022. It never reaches a value of 118 in mid-2022.

errors.text_span: Im Oktober 2022 verzeichnet die Linie einen sprunghaften Anstieg auf exakt 141,2
errors.evidence: The description states the purple line (statutory minimum wage) jumps to exactly 141.2. This value (141.2) is taken from the legend of the dark blue line (collectively agreed hourly wages), which uses it as an index reference point for October 2022. The purple line's value at this point is approximately 141, but specifying it as exactly 141.2 is a misattribution of information from a different data series.

errors.text_span: Sie setzt im Oktober 2022 bei einem Wert von 141,2 an
errors.evidence: The dark blue line starts in July 2022 at a value of approximately 138, not in October 2022. The description confuses the index reference point from the legend (October 2022 = 141.2) with the starting point of the line on the graph.
The dark blue line ends at the x-axis tick for January 2025. January is in winter, not spring ('Frühjahr').
